summary: Full House Resorts filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary FHR-Illinois LLC and the City of Waukegan, Illinois executed Amendment No. 1 on September 2, 2026 to their January 18, 2023 Development and Host Community Agreement for the American Place casino project. The amendment extends the permanent facility construction completion deadline to February 17, 2029, with operations starting within three months thereafter, permits retention of the temporary casino structure for five years after the permanent casino opens, and revises project phasing details. This is a routine municipal development agreement amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed.
